explanation: `\begin{itemize}` on line 3 was still open when TeX reached `\end{enumerate}`, so the two do not match. Either `\end{itemize}` is missing before this point, or this `\end{enumerate}` should read `\end{itemize}`.
rawMessage: LaTeX Error: \begin{itemize} on input line 3 ended by \end{enumerate}.
title: `itemize` was closed with `\end{enumerate}`
